visual.description: Primary dark background used across the main site sections and hero area.
Deepest near-black used in the hero section and very top announcement bar.
Slightly lighter dark surface used for cards, tag chips, and interactive containers.
Near-white used for large headings and prominent display text on dark backgrounds.
Slightly muted white used for body copy and secondary text on dark backgrounds.
Mid-grey used for subdued labels, captions, and less prominent UI text.
Signature pink-red used for CTAs, accent underscores, and brand highlights — the single warm frequency in an otherwise cold spectrum.
Nav bar background in the top-of-page transparent/overlay state matches page background.
Nav link text color in the top-of-page state.
Nav background after scroll — same dark tone, now opaque and distinct from content.
Nav link text after scroll — same near-white as the initial state.
Pink accent used on the logo mark and inline emphasis text.
Subtle light border used on card outlines and dividers in dark sections.
Elevated surface color for darker card variants and dropdown backgrounds.
Dark background of the footer area matching the main page background.
Muted grey used for footer column headings and link text.
